question: After the prerequisite PRs land, does the rebased exact-head hosted evidence demonstrate complete, credential-safe repair receipt publication without changing primary repair outcomes?
rationale: The source design is coherent, but cross-job GitHub Actions artifact, failure, and credential behavior cannot be conclusively established until the final stack is rebased and exercised on hosted infrastructure.

options.title: Require final hosted evidence
options.body: Inspect one successful and one intentionally failed repair run plus their durable ledger artifacts on the final rebased head before merge.

options.title: Accept source and checks
options.body: Merge after rebasing and required checks pass without requiring a hosted intentional-failure artifact.

recommendation.title: Require final hosted evidence
recommendation.body: Inspect one successful and one intentionally failed repair run plus their durable ledger artifacts on the final rebased head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the complete ledger stack and have the strongest context to produce and interpret the final integrated artifacts.
